# Plugins Popup Implementation Report

## 1. Files implementing the plugins popup UI

The plugins popup is **not a bespoke widget** — it is built on top of the generic `ListSelectionView` selection-popup component. The plugin-specific logic lives in:

- **`/workspace/repo/codex-rs/tui/src/chatwidget/plugins.rs`** (1098 lines) — all plugin popup construction, state, and event handling (implemented as an `impl ChatWidget` block).
- **`/workspace/repo/codex-rs/tui/src/bottom_pane/list_selection_view.rs`** (2195 lines) — the generic list/selection popup that actually renders. Defines `SelectionItem`, `SelectionViewParams`, `ListSelectionView`, key handling, and tab support.
- **`/workspace/repo/codex-rs/tui/src/bottom_pane/selection_tabs.rs`** (103 lines) — the tab-bar model and rendering (`SelectionTab`, `render_tab_bar`, `tab_bar_height`).
- **`/workspace/repo/codex-rs/tui/src/bottom_pane/mod.rs`** — `show_selection_view` / `replace_selection_view_if_active` entry points on `BottomPane`.

Data model lives in **`/workspace/repo/codex-rs/app-server-protocol/src/protocol/v2.rs`**.

Tests: `/workspace/repo/codex-rs/tui/src/chatwidget/tests/popups_and_settings.rs`, helpers in `/workspace/repo/codex-rs/tui/src/chatwidget/tests/helpers.rs`.

## 2. How the plugins popup is currently structured

There is no `PluginsPopup` struct. Instead, `ChatWidget` builds a `SelectionViewParams` (a plain config object) via `plugins_popup_params()` and hands it to `self.bottom_pane.show_selection_view(...)`, which constructs a generic `ListSelectionView`. The popup is identified by a constant view id so it can be replaced in place:

`plugins.rs:37`
```rust
const PLUGINS_SELECTION_VIEW_ID: &str = "plugins-selection";
```

Rendering flow: `plugins_popup_params` (`plugins.rs:706-831`) flattens every marketplace's plugins into `(marketplace, plugin, display_name)` tuples, sorts them (installed first, then case-insensitive name, then name, id), and builds one `SelectionItem` per plugin. The header is a `ColumnRenderable` with "Plugins", a subtitle, and an "Installed N of M available plugins." count line. The list is searchable (`is_searchable: true`), single-line rows (`SelectionRowDisplay::SingleLine`), auto-width columns (`ColumnWidthMode::AutoAllRows`). Each item's `actions` closure dispatches `AppEvent::OpenPluginDetailLoading` + `AppEvent::FetchPluginDetail`.

Key excerpt (`plugins.rs:819-831`):
```rust

            view_id: Some(PLUGINS_SELECTION_VIEW_ID),
            header: Box::new(header),
            footer_hint: Some(plugins_popup_hint_line()),
            items,
            is_searchable: true,
            search_placeholder: Some("Type to search plugins".to_string()),
            col_width_mode: ColumnWidthMode::AutoAllRows,
            row_display: SelectionRowDisplay::SingleLine,

            ..Default::default()

```

There are several *variants* of the popup, each a `*_popup_params()` method returning `SelectionViewParams` with the same `PLUGINS_SELECTION_VIEW_ID`: loading (`plugins_loading_popup_params`), error (`plugins_error_popup_params`), plugin detail (`plugin_detail_popup_params`, `plugins.rs:833-970`), detail loading/error, install/uninstall loading, and the install-auth flow (`plugin_install_auth_popup_params`). They swap into the same view id via `replace_selection_view_if_active`.

## 5. How the popup is opened / constructed from ChatWidget

Entry point is the `/plugins` slash command:

- `slash_dispatch.rs:320-321`: `SlashCommand::Plugins => { self.add_plugins_output(); }`
- `add_plugins_output` (`plugins.rs:135-158`): checks the `Feature::Plugins` flag, calls `prefetch_plugins()`, then branches on `plugins_cache_for_current_cwd()`:
  - `Ready(response)` → `open_plugins_popup(&response)`
  - `Failed(err)` → error history cell
  - `Loading`/`Uninitialized` → `open_plugins_loading_popup()`

Data flow: `prefetch_plugins` (`plugins.rs:196-208`) sends `AppEvent::FetchPluginsList { cwd }` and sets `plugins_cache = Loading`. When the fetch completes, `on_plugins_loaded` (`plugins.rs:160-194`) stores `plugins_cache = Ready(response)` and calls `refresh_plugins_popup_if_open`, which calls `replace_selection_view_if_active(PLUGINS_SELECTION_VIEW_ID, self.plugins_popup_params(response))`.

`open_plugins_popup` (`plugins.rs:228-231`):
```rust
    fn open_plugins_popup(&mut self, response: &PluginListResponse) {
        self.bottom_pane
            .show_selection_view(self.plugins_popup_params(response));
    }
```

Selecting a plugin row fires (from the item's `actions`, `plugins.rs:792-803`) `AppEvent::OpenPluginDetailLoading` then `AppEvent::FetchPluginDetail { cwd, params: PluginReadParams { marketplace_path, plugin_name } }`. Detail arrives at `on_plugin_detail_loaded` (`plugins.rs:254-284`) → `plugin_detail_popup_params`. Install/uninstall similarly go through `on_plugin_install_loaded` (`plugins.rs:286-344`) and `on_plugin_uninstall_loaded` (`plugins.rs:346-376`), with an app-auth follow-up flow (`plugin_install_auth_popup_params`, `plugins.rs:413-512`).

## 7. Existing tab / tabbed-interface patterns

There is a ready-made, generic tab system already wired into `ListSelectionView`, but **currently only exercised by tests** (no production popup uses tabs yet). This is exactly the pattern to model after.

`selection_tabs.rs:14-19`:
```rust
pub(crate) struct SelectionTab {
    pub(crate) id: String,
    pub(crate) label: String,
    pub(crate) header: Box<dyn Renderable>,
    pub(crate) items: Vec<SelectionItem>,
}
```
Each tab carries its own header and its own item list. `render_tab_bar` (`selection_tabs.rs:31-52`) and `tab_bar_height` (`21-29`) render a wrapping bar; the active tab is drawn as `[Label]` in cyan/bold, inactive tabs dimmed (`tab_unit`, `selection_tabs.rs:93-103`).

Wiring in `list_selection_view.rs`:
- `SelectionViewParams.tabs: Vec<SelectionTab>` and `initial_tab_id: Option<String>` (`list_selection_view.rs:156-157`).
- `ListSelectionView` holds `tabs` + `active_tab_idx: Option<usize>` (`233-234`). `tabs_enabled()` is `active_tab_idx.is_some()` (`337-339`).
- Constructor resolves `active_tab_idx` from `initial_tab_id` (`281-291`).
- `active_items()` / `active_header()` / `active_tab_id()` (`341-359`) return the current tab's items/header, or fall back to the top-level `items`/`header` when there are no tabs.
- Rendering reserves height for the tab bar and draws it (`857-859`, `920-978`).

To make the plugins popup tabbed (e.g., one tab per marketplace), you'd populate `SelectionViewParams.tabs` instead of `items` in `plugins_popup_params`, giving each `SelectionTab` an `id` (e.g. marketplace name/path), a `label`, its own header `ColumnRenderable`, and the per-marketplace `Vec<SelectionItem>`.

## 8. Left/right arrow handling in the popup

Arrow handling is centralized in `ListSelectionView::handle_key_event` (`list_selection_view.rs:688-790`). Left/Right switch tabs **only when tabs are enabled** (otherwise they are ignored / fall through):

`list_selection_view.rs:706-713`:
```rust
            KeyEvent {
                code: KeyCode::Left,
                ..
            } if self.tabs_enabled() => self.switch_tab(/*step*/ -1),
            KeyEvent {
                code: KeyCode::Right,
                ..
            } if self.tabs_enabled() => self.switch_tab(/*step*/ 1),
```

`switch_tab` (`list_selection_view.rs:479-501`) wraps around (`checked_sub(1).unwrap_or(len-1)` / `(idx+1) % len`), clears the search query, resets scroll, re-applies the filter, selects the first enabled row, and fires the selection-changed callback:
```rust
    fn switch_tab(&mut self, step: isize) {
        let Some(active_idx) = self.active_tab_idx else {
            return;
        };
        let len = self.tabs.len();
        if len == 0 {
            return;
        }
        let next_idx = if step.is_negative() {
            active_idx.checked_sub(1).unwrap_or(len - 1)
        } else {
            (active_idx + 1) % len
        };
        self.active_tab_idx = Some(next_idx);
        self.search_query.clear();
        self.state.reset();
        self.apply_filter();
        if self.state.selected_idx.is_none() {
            self.select_first_enabled_row();
        }
        self.fire_selection_changed();
    }
```

Up/Down (and Ctrl-P/N, plus j/k when not searchable) drive `move_up`/`move_down` (`list_selection_view.rs:693-737`); Enter accepts (`783-787`); Esc cancels (`745-749`); when searchable, printable chars append to the search query (`750-760`).
